title: Ulyana and the Drop
author: Xanthe Sterling
blurb: Rafael Underhill, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
